from semver import replace, VersionInfo

# Test replace function
print('replace major:', replace('1.2.3', major=2))  # Should be '2.0.0'
print('replace minor:', replace('1.2.3', minor=5))  # Should be '1.5.0'
print('replace patch:', replace('1.2.3', patch=4))  # Should be '1.2.4'
print('replace prerelease:', replace('1.2.3-alpha', prerelease='beta'))
print('replace build:', replace('1.2.3-alpha+build', build='release'))

# Test VersionInfo.replace method
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
print('VersionInfo.replace major:', v.replace(major=2))
print('VersionInfo.replace minor:', v.replace(minor=5))
"
